profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer – AI, Network Automation, & Reliability
profile.summary:
_______________________Software built to last is engineered, not generated.______________________

Hi I’m Joseph Lee, a software engineer at heart who loves creating, building, shipping, and innovating. My passion lies in designing systems that scale whether that means architecting distributed platforms, ensuring reliability at massive throughput, or pushing the boundaries of complex AI applications.

I believe scalability isn’t an afterthought, it’s something you bake into the design. From my experience building mission-critical software at IBM to founding multiple startups, I’ve seen firsthand how the right architecture and foresight can make or break a product’s future.

What excites me most are distributed systems, AI at scale, and the challenge of turning ambitious ideas into production-ready software. While my technical expertise spans languages and frameworks across the stack, my true strength is connecting those skills with a broad network of talents, so when it’s time to change the world, I know how to bring the right people and technology together.

At my core, I’m an engineer who thrives on solving hard problems and shipping things that matter.

positions.title: Software Engineer – AI, Network Automation, & Reliability
positions.description:
At IBM, I’ve held progressive roles spanning backend engineering, AI model deployment, and large-scale network automation. My work bridges distributed systems, reliability, and applied AI, with a focus on building scalable solutions across cloud, infrastructure, and enterprise software.

-  Deployed and maintained AI vision models (Detectron2, YOLOv3, Faster R-CNN, anomaly detection) into Maximo Visual Inspection using Java, Python, Go, C++, and OpenShift.
- Built SDKs, CI/CD pipelines, and automated network inventory management on IBM Cloud; integrated systems including SevOne, NetBox, Forward Networks, Juniper Mist, Palo Alto, Cisco SD-WAN, and Versa.
- Engineered full-stack network monitoring solutions with IBM Watson AI, Cisco DNA, ThousandEyes, and ServiceNow, enhancing visibility and reducing downtime.
- Collaborated cross-functionally to deliver secure, scalable solutions for enterprise infrastructure and AI-driven operations.
 - Currently creating dependable AI infrastructure

projects.title: Nexus Leads – Automated Marketing Campaign Platform
projects.description: Created a platform that allowed companies to design campaigns around specific customer personas and automatically generate targeted outreach. The system collected lead information, launched campaigns, and executed automated follow-ups through text and email. After securing an initial client, we identified significant ethical and legal implications around data collection and outreach compliance. This realization led to winding down the project, serving as a valuable learning experience in balancing innovation with responsibility.

projects.title: MenuVision
projects.description: Developed a mobile application that scanned restaurant menus and transformed them into an interactive dining guide. The app generated visual previews of each dish, suggested complementary sides and beverages, and provided historical and cultural context. It also broke down ingredients to help users make informed choices. In effect, it acted as a personalized dining assistant—bridging food visualization, pairing recommendations, and culinary education into a seamless experience.

organizations.name: YEA (Young Entrepreneurs Academy)
organizations.description: Developed a business plan consisting of short/long term goals, competitive advantages, market analysis and financial statements resulting in a clear vision of the companies why. Recruited, Trained and Managed a team of three.
